name: Boom
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level bard 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

A loud thundercrack is created next to the ear of your target. He instantly suffers 1 point of sonic damage. In addition, he must make a Fortitude save or suffer a -2 penalty to Concentration checks for 1d3 rounds because of the ringing in the ears.
